description: This file implements the 'BudgetsScreen' widget in Flutter, which displays and manages budget data for different categories within a given month. It fetches budget and category data from repositories, displays a list of budgets with progress indicators, and allows editing and saving budget amounts.

classes.name: BudgetsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays a list of budgets for categories, allows editing amounts, and visualizes spending with progress bars.

classes.name: _BudgetsScreenState
classes.description: State class for the BudgetsScreen widget, managing data fetching, user interactions, and UI updates.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads budget data on widget creation.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes all TextEditingControllers when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches categories, budgets, and spent totals from repositories and updates the state.

methods.name: _saveBudget
methods.description: Saves the updated budget amount for a specific category.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, showing a loading indicator or the list of budget cards.
